Places an order for each item, on paper or live as the workflow trades: the copy Copy sizing worked out, or one of its own settings. Filled orders go out of main, those that did not fill out of missed.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | `trading.placeOrder` |
| Kind | Node |
| Inputs | `main` |
| Outputs | `main`, `missed` |

Items that fail stop the execution, unless **Continue on failure** is on: then they leave on the `error` port instead.

## Settings

| Setting | Kind | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Order (`from`) | text | no | `copy` | copy: the order Copy sizing worked out. settings: the order these settings make. One of `copy`, `settings`. |
| Token (`tokenId`) | text | no |  | For settings: the outcome's token ID. |
| Side (`side`) | text | no |  | For settings. One of `buy`, `sell`. |
| Price (`price`) | number | no |  | For settings: the limit, the most a buy pays per share or the least a sell takes. |
| Shares (`shares`) | number | no |  | For settings: how many to buy or sell. |
| Dollars (`dollars`) | number | no |  | For settings: a buy of so many dollars instead of shares. |
| Type (`type`) | text | no | `FAK` | For settings. FAK: what the book has within the price. FOK: all of it, or nothing. One of `FAK`, `FOK`. |

## Items

The items it receives, passed on with these fields added. Decimals are text, so they stay exact; times are RFC 3339 text.

| Field | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `order` | object | The order placed, and how it went. |
| `order.id` | text | Its ID in the workflow's orders. |
| `order.mode` | text, one of `paper`, `live` | paper: simulated against the live book. live: on Polymarket, from the workflow's wallet. |
| `order.status` | text, one of `filled`, `partial`, `unfilled`, `refused`, `pending`, `failed` | filled, partial (the rest cancelled), unfilled or refused; live, also pending (sent, its outcome not known yet: followed) or failed (matched, but its trades failed on chain). |
| `order.reason` | text; or null | Why it was refused or did not fill wholly. |
| `order.shares` | decimal | Shares it got or sold. |
| `order.dollars` | decimal | Dollars they came to. |
| `order.fees` | decimal | Fees paid, in dollars. |
| `order.price` | decimal; or null | The average price per share; null when nothing filled. |
